name: zipdev.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 41 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.zipdev.com scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw HubSpot (1 request), Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies __cf_bm on hs-scripts.com, __cf_bm on usemessages.com, __cf_bm on hsadspixel.net, __cf_bm on hs-analytics.net,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 41 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /services/, /about-us/, /hire-remote/ and 4 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 118 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: zipdev.com (118). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.zipdev.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject All" and reloading, HubSpot (1 request), Meta Pixel (1 request) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 75 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 75 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /services/, /about-us/, /careers/ and 71 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 295 ms
Every page has a meta description
